mainEntity.name: How much does a Hyundai Kona 1.6 CRDi engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rebuilt Hyundai Kona 1.6 CRDi (D4FD) engine typically costs between £1,200 and £2,800 for supply only. Used units start around £800, while supply and fit labour typically adds £500-£850 depending on the specialist.

mainEntity.name: What are the common problems with the Hyundai Kona 1.6 CRDi engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common issues are glow plug failure causing cold start difficulties, and DPF clogging from frequent short-trip urban driving. Turbo actuator sticking is also reported on higher-mileage examples.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Hyundai Kona 1.6 CRDi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With a well-maintained Kona 1.6 CRDi valued between £6,000 and £16,000, a £1,200-£2,800 reconditioned engine replacement is a financially sound investment that restores reliability and protects the vehicle's retained value.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a Hyundai Kona 1.6 CRDi engine supplied and fitted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, EnginesMarket connects you with vetted UK specialists offering Hyundai Kona 1.6 CRDi engine supply and fit nationwide. All fitted engines include a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty for complete peace of mind.
